about: A .meshgraph from a spec: a Composer shape (../SDFs/Mushroom.sdf) roughened by a noise graph, remeshed to about 30000 triangles, unwrapped and written to out/mushroom_rough.obj. The field is the shape's signed distance plus the noise: Add. Build next to the SDFs/Noises folders (this file's folder works). Run it with: noiser --headless --mesh-graph out.meshgraph
